editorial:
Imagine you are on a road trip through the beautiful Pyrenees mountains with your partner. You find a huge, old Spanish castle and decide to spend the night, thinking it will be a cozy break. But instead of a warm welcome, you walk right into a nightmare. You quickly realize the castle is actually a secret base for a group of witches who have some very dark plans for you. The vibe is creepy and mysterious, making you feel like you are trapped in a place where the rules of the real world just do not apply anymore.

What really works here is the slow build-up of tension and the strange, trippy visuals. The acting is solid for the time, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you are used to modern jump scares. If you love old-school horror with a weird twist, you will really enjoy this one. You should definitely try to find the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or see if you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the end, the couple discovers they are meant to be sacrifices for a dark ritual. The witches try to trap them in a cycle of madness and death. After a frantic struggle to escape the castle, the movie leaves you with a chilling feeling that the evil presence of the coven might not be gone for good. It wraps up by showing that once you enter the mountain, you can never truly leave behind the horror you saw.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old European horror and witch stories.
